articles.title: Godrej Consumer Products completes acquisition of FMCG business from Trilogy Solutions
articles.snippet: Godrej Consumer Products Limited signed a definitive agreement to acquire the FMCG business, including the Muuchstac brand, from Trilogy Solutions Private Limited for INR 4.5 billion. The deal includes a cash consideration of INR 2.89 billion and an earnout of INR 1.6 billion, approved by the board of directors.
